title: 地图联动图文行程
prompt: “帮我规划下杭州西湖游玩的计划，能调整节奏。”
program:
root = Col([intro, planner, note])
$pace = "经典"
$day = "第1天"
paceValue = $pace == "轻松" ? 1 : ($pace == "经典" ? 2 : 3)
dayNumber = $day == "第1天" ? 1 : ($day == "第2天" ? 2 : 3)
daySpots = @Filter(@Filter(allSpots, "day", "==", dayNumber), "pace", "<=", paceValue)
spotCount = @Count(daySpots)
totalMinutes = @Sum(daySpots.minutes)
currentDuration = @Duration(totalMinutes * 60, "short")
dayTheme = dayNumber == 1 ? "湖滨经典线" : (dayNumber == 2 ? "南山雷峰线" : "北山幽静线")
dayIntro = dayNumber == 1 ? "从断桥沿白堤到孤山，适合傍晚看平湖秋月。" : (dayNumber == 2 ? "苏堤纵贯湖面，花港观鱼与雷峰塔可安排半天。" : "曲院风荷与茅家埠更安静，适合放慢脚步。")
spotBadges = @Each(daySpots, "s", Badge(s.name + " · " + s.minutes + "分钟", "purple", "clock"))
spotRow = Row(spotBadges, 1, null, null, true)
controls = Col([SegmentedControl($pace, ["轻松", "经典", "充实"], true), SegmentedControl($day, ["第1天", "第2天", "第3天"], true), Row([Icon("footprints", "sm"), Text("第" + dayNumber + "天 · " + spotCount + " 个点 · 约 " + currentDuration, "sm", "ink", "medium")], 1), Caption("轻松只留主线，充实会加入更多支线。")], 3)
dayItem = TravelItem("第" + dayNumber + "天 · " + dayTheme, dayIntro, [DayBadge(dayNumber, "第" + dayNumber + "天")], [spotRow])
planner = TravelModule([controls, dayItem], "itinerary", "杭州西湖三日游", "示例行程：景点与停留时长可替换，不包含实时票务")
intro = Text("西湖不必一次走完。下面是一个三日示例行程，用两个开关调整“节奏”和“天数”，景点数量与预计时长会即时变化。")
note = Text("示例数据：雷峰塔、三潭印月等处的开放时间和船票请以官方为准，这里不会创建订单。", "sm", "muted")
allSpots = [{day:1, name:"断桥残雪", pace:1, minutes:40}, {day:1, name:"白堤", pace:1, minutes:40}, {day:1, name:"孤山", pace:2, minutes:60}, {day:1, name:"平湖秋月", pace:2, minutes:30}, {day:1, name:"西泠印社", pace:3, minutes:30}, {day:2, name:"苏堤", pace:1, minutes:60}, {day:2, name:"花港观鱼", pace:1, minutes:50}, {day:2, name:"三潭印月", pace:2, minutes:90}, {day:2, name:"雷峰塔", pace:2, minutes:60}, {day:2, name:"净慈寺", pace:3, minutes:30}, {day:3, name:"曲院风荷", pace:1, minutes:50}, {day:3, name:"岳王庙", pace:1, minutes:50}, {day:3, name:"杨公堤", pace:2, minutes:60}, {day:3, name:"茅家埠", pace:2, minutes:60}, {day:3, name:"龙井村", pace:3, minutes:120}]
